name: IntegrateIT LIFX
notes: Local Control4 driver for a single LIFX Wi-Fi light over the vendor's published LAN protocol — UDP binary on port 56700, no cloud and no account. Broadcast discovery finds bulbs on the subnet; you bind one, then control power, color (HSBK), and white temperature with polled state feedback. Confirmed LIFX Z / Beam strips add per-zone color, gradients, and the Move effect over SetExtendedColorZones; single-zone bulbs refuse zone commands by name.
